description.zh: 检查事实和假设，针对具体方案提出有依据的支持或异议。
description.en: Review evidence and assumptions; support or challenge specific proposals.

zh: 检查这个方案依赖哪些未证实的假设
哪些条件改变会让这个建议不成立
说明支持一个方案的依据与保留意见
en: Check the untested assumptions behind a proposal
Identify conditions that would invalidate this advice
Explain support and reservations about an option
